title: Document Management System Incident Response
description: Document management system incidents affecting legal document access
immediate_actions: Assess impact on legal operations and client matters
Implement alternative document access if available
Activate service desk for user support
resolution_steps: Restart document management services following standard procedures
Implement database fixes or restart if needed
Apply system patches or configuration changes
Coordinate with document management vendor for complex issues
verification: Confirm with legal staff that system is operational
special_considerations: Do not access or modify client matter files unless explicitly authorized
Security incidents involving privileged legal documents require immediate escalation
Maintain client confidentiality during system restoration
Document any system interruptions that may affect client deadlines
